record_title: A one-minimum curvature screen for hexahedral face quartics
provenance: Structural refinement of the exact face-quartic boundary-minimum reduction for trilinear hexahedra introduced in arXiv:2609.19926.
limitations: The result reduces stationary-candidate filtering and evaluation but does not reduce quartic root-solving degree or establish finite-precision runtime gains. The three-root sharpness witness is for the abstract face-polynomial coefficient class and is not claimed to be realized by a physical trilinear hexahedron. Higher-order finite elements are outside the statement. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
